annotations.title: Search Korea MFDS Functional Cosmetics & OEM Factories

description: Search 219,000+ official South Korea MFDS functional cosmetic filings in English or Korean to uncover Korean OEM/ODM factories and functional claims. Filter inputs accept English or Korean (common terms like "sunscreen", "Cosmax", "Kolmar" auto-bridge; unmapped English falls back to raw substring match), datasetType selects reported/reviewed/both registries, resolveOemFromReviewed joins reviewed base formulas to expose hidden factories, and maxItems/maxPagesToScan cap scan volume. Queries the live MFDS API (~5-20s; slower when resolveOemFromReviewed joins formulas) with transient retries and bills $2/1K records ($0 if empty). Use for K-Beauty OEM sourcing and R&D; do not use for recall checks (use search_korea_mfds_recalls instead).

brandOrDistributor.description: Brand or responsible seller in English or Korean, e.g. "Amorepacific", "Olive Young", "Medicube", or "아모레퍼시픽".

datasetType.description: Which MFDS registry to query: "reported" (198k+ brand filings), "reviewed" (20k+ OEM base formulas), or "both".

efficacyKeyword.description: Efficacy claim filter in English or Korean: "whitening", "anti-wrinkle", "uv-protection", "SPF", "hair-loss", "미백", "주름".

itemCode.description: Exact MFDS ITEM_SEQ or COSMETIC_REPORT_SEQ identifier for single-product lookup.

oemManufacturer.description: OEM/ODM factory in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Kolmar", "Cosmecca", or "코스맥스".

productName.description: Product keyword in English or Korean (e.g. "sunscreen", "retinol cream", "serum", "선크림") — English auto-translates server-side.

resolveOemFromReviewed.description: Query linked reviewed base formulas automatically to reveal hidden OEM/ODM factories when missing on reported filings.

name: search_korea_mfds_oem_filings

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Official South Korea MFDS functional cosmetic filings and OEM factory records.

spf.description: SPF sun protection value if applicable.
